{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# This ensures we can compare numerically
data['revenue_float'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now check for rows where revenue_float == 999999.99
qa_rows = data[data['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]

# Print the number of QA rows
print("Number of QA rows (revenue_float == 999999.99):", len(qa_rows))

# Show the actual values
print("Sample of QA rows:", qa_rows[['order_id', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_float']])"}
